categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, research and development, production, and sales of intelligent remote controls and smart products. The main business segments include family appliance intelligent remote controls (infrared and wireless remote controls) and smart products (smart home controllers, educational products, cloud gaming controllers, facial recognition devices, microphones, and cameras). The company serves as an ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) and OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) provider, offering comprehensive intelligent remote control solutions to customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include wireless human-machine interaction transmission technologies (2.4GHz, 433MHz, Bluetooth, WiFi, NFC, UWB), touch recognition, fingerprint recognition, voice recognition, and acceleration sensor applications. Production methods involve automated manufacturing systems including injection molding, SMT (Surface Mount Technology), IC programming, PCBA assembly, and functional testing. The company utilizes ERP, MES, QMS, PLM, and SRM systems for production management and follows IPD (Integrated Product Development) methodology for product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major domestic and international customers including Huawei, Xiaomi, Jimi, Changhong, Skyworth, Jiumu, China Telecom, Hisense, TCL, VESTEL, Panasonic, and UEIC. Primary end markets include smart televisions, set-top boxes, projectors, smart bathrooms, air conditioners, sweeping robots, and other smart home devices. The company serves over 100 customers annually with products applied across consumer electronics and smart home industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China (domestic market), Europe, Americas, and Asia-Pacific regions. International sales accounted for 61.39% of revenue in 2023. The company has established subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong, the United States, Japan, Singapore, India, and Vietnam. Manufacturing and R&D operations are primarily based in Huizhou, Guangdong Province, China, with additional facilities in Shenzhen and overseas locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. As an ODM/OEM provider, it receives design specifications and orders from major appliance and smart home manufacturers, then designs, manufactures, and delivers finished intelligent remote control products. The company sources electronic components, PCB boards, plastic materials, and other raw materials from suppliers, and outsources certain manufacturing processes (injection molding, SMT, coating, plating) while maintaining core assembly and testing operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include expanding into new markets (Americas, Japan, Korea, India), developing new product categories in smart bathrooms and automotive entertainment, and advancing next-generation wireless technologies including UWB (Ultra-Wideband) space positioning, StarFlash technology, and solar energy technology. R&D initiatives focus on multi-technology product combinations, smart home ecosystem expansion, and applications in new domains such as smart healthcare beds and central air conditioning control systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of intelligent remote controls and smart products using ODM and OEM business models. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon shipment and customer acceptance. The company operates on an order-based production model ('以销定产'), where production is determined by customer orders and sales contracts. Revenue streams include domestic direct sales, export sales, and sales through various distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of China's leading intelligent remote control manufacturers with strong core competitiveness. Domestic competitors include Weida Intelligent, Difu Electronics, and Chaoran Technology. International competitors include Universal Electronics Inc. (UEIC), the world's largest remote control manufacturer, and Home Control. The company ranks among the top domestic producers by revenue scale, significantly exceeding domestic competitors but maintaining a gap compared to UEIC in global market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated revenue of 720.14 million yuan in 2023, representing a 3.31% decline from 744.78 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 90.62 million yuan in 2023, up 2.23% from 88.64 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 1.344 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 147.45% from 543.13 million yuan at year-end 2022, primarily due to IPO proceeds. The company went public on the ChiNext board of Shenzhen Stock Exchange on December 28, 2023, raising 523.64 million yuan in net proceeds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive intelligent remote control solutions combining advanced wireless transmission technologies, multi-protocol support (2.4GHz, 433MHz, Bluetooth, WiFi, UWB), and integrated hardware-software design capabilities. Key competitive advantages include rapid market response capability, strong R&D and technical integration capabilities, established relationships with major brand customers, superior product quality management systems (ISO9001, ISO14001, ISO45001, ISO27001, QC080000 certified), and global operational presence. The company emphasizes customized solutions, quick product development cycles, and reliable delivery to major appliance manufacturers.
